sentences.text:
Namita Gupta & Ors vs Unknown on 1 December, 2025
01.12.2025
Sl. No.60
Amr
Ct.No.42
 Crr 821 of 2025

In the matter of : Namita Gupta & Ors.
 .... Petitioners
 Ms. Debishree Adhimary
 ...for the Petitioners

1 . 
The present petition has been filed for quashing of G.R. No. 5359 of 2023 arising out of English Bazar Police Station FIR No. 1274 of 2023 under Sections 498A, 308, 325, 406, 506 and 34 IPC read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1986.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that no offence is made out against the petitioners,
who are mother-in-law, father-in-law and sister-in-law of the O.P. No. 2.
3. Issue notice to the State through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor.
4. O.P. 2 be also served.

5. List the matter in the Combined Monthly List of February, 2026.
(Dinesh Kumar Sharma, J.)
